sector: Food Safety Diagnostics / Animal Health (May FYE)
drawdown_context: NEOG closed at $6.56 on 2025-05-15, -63% from 52-wk-prior peak. The drawdown reflects (a) the FY24 GAAP net loss of $9.4M on $924M revenue (vs $48M profit in FY22 pre-3M FSD), (b) two persisting material weaknesses (ITGCs and invoice accruals) with an adverse ICFR opinion from BDO, (c) a $461.4M goodwill impairment in Q2 FY25 (Sep 1 2024 triggering event) wiping 22% of the $2.135B Food Safety goodwill from the 3M FSD reverse-Morris-trust acquisition (closed Sept 2022 for ~$5.3B EV), (d) a New material-weakness AREA disclosed in Q2 FY25 (goodwill valuation review controls -- the same control category mgmt had declared 'remediated' in the FY24 10-K), (e) chronic ERP/3M-distribution-transition disruption (sample collection product line, Petrifilm duplicate startup, transition manufacturing relationship), and (f) a $902M debt stack (incl 8.625% senior notes due 2030) refinanced April 4, 2025 with the revolver DRAWN $100M for the first time ever -- five days before the CEO step-down announcement (April 9, 2025). Strict-cutoff framework signal points to HIGH-DISTRESS; the actual post-cutoff forward return was +35.7%, suggesting the bad news was already priced in to the -63% drawdown OR the framework over-weighted the integration tells in a 'cycle bottom honesty' situation.

rfm_tuples.R: We identified material weaknesses in our internal control over financial reporting related to ineffective information technology general controls, our period-end invoice accrual procedures, and ineffective operation of management review controls related to the accounting, valuation and purchase price allocation of the Company's acquisition and associated goodwill. ... As of May 31, 2024, management believes our remediation efforts have been effective and that one of our previous material weaknesses in our internal control over financial reporting has been remediated. Specifically, management believes the operation of management review controls related to the accounting, valuation and purchase price allocation of the Company's acquisitions and associated goodwill is effective.
rfm_tuples.f: Mode A: confirm scope and remediation status of the three MWs; verify adverse ICFR opinion from BDO. Mode B: a MW asserted as 'remediated' in the 10-K should stay remediated in subsequent 10-Qs. Test claim_evolution across Q1/Q2/Q3 FY25 (filed Oct 10, 2024 / Jan 15, 2025 / Apr 9, 2025).

rfm_tuples.M_value: Mode A confirmed: BDO USA issued ADVERSE ICFR opinion as of May 31, 2024 (two persisting MWs: ITGCs + invoice accruals). Mode B FAILED HARD: the Q2 FY25 10-Q (filed Jan 15, 2025) reclassifies the MW disclosure into COSO Framework component buckets (Control Activities + Information & Communication) and ADDS BACK an MW area mgmt said was remediated in the 10-K: 'Management did not maintain effective management review controls to adequately support certain assumptions applied in its goodwill valuation analysis.' This is the EXACT SAME control area the 10-K said was now effective. The re-emergence of the goodwill-valuation-review MW coincides with the $461.4M goodwill impairment recognized in the same quarter (Sep 1, 2024 triggering event). MW still unremediated as of Q3 FY25 (Feb 28, 2025); mgmt hired a 'full-time Director of Internal Controls' (Q3 disclosure) -- a tell that the function was previously understaffed.
rfm_tuples.interpretation: Textbook Mode-B claim-evolution failure: the FY24 10-K declared the goodwill-valuation MW remediated, and three months later mgmt re-identified an MW in the same area concurrent with a $461M goodwill writedown. Either the original 'remediation' was unsupported, or the new $461M valuation requires unsupported assumptions. Either way the auditor's adverse ICFR opinion proved directionally optimistic -- the MW universe expanded after the audit date.

rfm_tuples.M_value: Mode B FAILED: Q1 FY25 (Aug 31, 2024) revenue -5.2% YoY ($217M vs $229M); Q2 FY25 -0.4% ex-currency; Q3 FY25 -3.4% YoY. summary: NEOG FY24 10-K is a high-distress disclosure mostly hidden behind an 'integration largely resolved' narrative that was contradicted within 92 days. Framework verdict: SHORT-tier on Mode B claim-evolution. The most decisive tells are (a) the BDO ADVERSE ICFR opinion with the goodwill-valuation MW asserted as remediated, immediately followed by a $461M Food Safety goodwill impairment in Q2 FY25 and re-emergence of the same MW area (C1+C3); (b) the FY24 'order fulfillment largely resolved' claim contradicted by three subsequent 10-Qs disclosing persistent sample collection delays, Petrifilm duplicate startup costs, and lost market share (C2); (c) the April 4, 2025 debt refinancing (extended maturity to 2030, first-ever revolver draw of $100M) landing 5 days before the CEO Adent step-down announcement on the exact day of the Q3 10-Q filing (C4+C5); (d) the $902M debt + $127.7M cash + zero buyback + covenant-constrained capital allocation (C6). PASS-tier signals: no insider 10b5-1 selling during the drawdown (C9), no auditor change, no going-concern language, no restatement. The 3M FSD reverse-Morris-trust integration (C7) is the proximate cause of the goodwill impairment, the debt stack, the MWs, and the CEO change -- a single capital-allocation tell explaining ~70% of the bear case. Important caveat: the actual post-cutoff forward return was +35.7%, which means the framework's HIGH-DISTRESS signal was directionally correct on disclosure quality but the -63% drawdown had already priced in most of the bad news; this resembles a 'cycle-bottom honesty' case where the lying detector still fires (correctly) on the dishonest claim-evolution but the price was the floor.
